reviews.author: Bronx Bull
reviews.text: I am an experienced lifter and have worked with Titan Forge and Steve for over a month with the goal to increase my power strength by 10%-20%. The data-driven dialed-in analysis of how to do so has been incredible. What differentiates Titan from other trainers is the approach of performance architecture versus the one-size-fits-all model of others trainers/fitness groups. I'll be working with Titan for quite sometime!  -Brian Mena

reviews.author: Ignacio Martinez
reviews.text: Steve has been a massive part of my weight loss journey. I’ve went from 225 to 175 in 4 months, then gained a ton of muscle the last two years with his program. Incredible support. Such an amazing team. Can not recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Conor McCutcheon
reviews.text: Overall a great experience and crew over at titan forge. Kris and Steve really know what they’re doing and are so devoted to making your goals reality.

reviews.author: Robert Scheafer
reviews.text: Steve and the team show tremendous passion for there roles and make it easy to achieve my goals.

reviews.author: Tucker Thompson
reviews.text:
Titan Forge has been a total game-changer! From the very first phone call, I knew I’d found the right place. For just over three months, I’ve been training with Steve “Doc,” and the results have blown me away. I went from never working out to being in the gym nearly every day — all thanks to Doc’s incredible guidance, encouragement, and expertise.

What sets Doc apart is that he doesn’t just coach you through the workouts — he’s there for you on a personal level, too. That kind of support has been life-changing for me.

If you’re serious about transforming not only your fitness, but your mindset and confidence, I highly recommend Titan Forge. I can’t wait to see what the future holds as I continue this amazing journey!

reviews.author: Janica Winn
reviews.text: I trained with Kris from June 2025 to September 2026. His training has had a significant positive impact on my fitness journey. He stands out for his willingness to vary exercises according to my physical needs. In addition, for introducing me to the advanced technique of forced reps. It’s amazing what can be achieved with Kris’ expertise!

reviews.author: Skyler Rauch
reviews.text: The guys at Titan Forge are amazing! I've been training with Kris for the past month and I've honestly been having the best time. Everyone I've met is super friendly and so responsive and supportive! I couldn't imagine a better experience.
